_about: The game system's skeleton: currencies, categories and their limits, the force, and the stat-line layouts. tools/build.py turns this, data/company.json, data/rules.json and the imported N5 armory into 'Dogs of War.gst' and 'Mercenary Company.cat'. Edit these files, not the .gst/.cat: those are rebuilt from scratch every time.

gameSystem.name: Dogs of War
gameSystem.readme: Dogs of War is an unofficial, non-commercial fan game mode for Infinity N5: mercenary companies built around one custom TAG and its pilot. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Corvus Belli S.L.; Infinity and all associated names, rules and game data are (c) Corvus Belli S.L. N5 weapon profiles and rule names come from the official Infinity wiki (https://infinitythewiki.com); rule summaries are our own, and each links to its full official text, which wins wherever the two differ. Dogs of War's own rules: https://github.com/OptimusPrimarch/DogsOfWar/blob/main/rules/core-rules.md

costTypes.name: Command Tokens
costTypes._note: Pre-game spends only. The limit becomes the starting pool once it's set.

costTypes.name: Capacity
costTypes._note: TAG components. Each chassis caps its own Capacity.

categories.name: TAG
categories.description: The company's custom TAG. Acts in the Pilot phase, with its pilot.

categories.name: Pilot
categories.description: Acts in the Pilot phase. A second pilot also counts toward the Elite Guns limit.

categories.name: Elite Guns
categories.description: Acts in the Elite Guns phase.

categories.name: Hired Guns
categories.description: Acts in the Hired Guns phase.

categories.name: Company
categories.description: Company-wide items: the briefing and contract extras. Not units.

categories.name: Specialist
categories.description: Counts as a Specialist for scenarios.

categories.name: Deployed
categories.description: Infantry on the table at the start of the game: 5 at most (TAGs and pilots don't count). Elite Guns starting in reserve don't count.
